NFI.gap: No global frame mode: the model checks member Euler, member yield, tube local buckling and film only. Snap-through or general-instability of the whole stiffened sphere between nodes is unmodelled, and MAINLINE-004's spherical knockdown therefore neither applies to nor rescales any P3 number.
NFI.direction: Add an equivalent-stiffened-shell general-instability check (ribbed-sphere analogy) before any P3 number is read as a whole-vehicle figure.
NFI.effect: Could only lower the P3 rows; the aluminum plateau's flatness and the material ranking survive any such factor applied uniformly.

NFI.gap: The unconstrained optimum rides the node-mass saving to s=6.4 m (V=37 nodes), where the equal-triangle continuum behind V(s) is no longer a defensible reading; the reported optimum is cut at s<=3.0 m (V>=161), suppressing 0.0002 of SF.
NFI.direction: Re-run on real geodesic layouts (unequal members, real tributary areas) if a design point is ever picked.
NFI.effect: At most +0.1 percent on aluminum; no ranking change.

NFI.gap: sigma_local = 0.6*E*t_w/r_o is SP-8007 classical with gamma=1 (no imperfection knockdown). At the aluminum best, local sits 3.9x above the least SF, so the answer is robust; at the T700 best the margin is 1.18x, and a gamma of 0.65 would pull that point's local to ~0.59.
NFI.direction: Re-optimise r_o under a knocked-down local curve: at s=1 the local margin is 2.6x, so the material conclusion (T700 least ~0.76, yield-bound) survives down to gamma ~0.29 after re-optimisation.
NFI.effect: The best-point geometry moves; the least SF per material does not.

NFI.gap: SiC's 3900 MPa is a crushing value; 008's own NFI carries that flexural ~380 MPa governs any bending or tension path, with brittle fracture, joining and handling unresolved. A 0.04 m radius sintered SiC tube of 1.3 mm wall is undemonstrated.
NFI.direction: Treat the SiC row as a material-boundary statement (sigma/rho headroom), not a buildable tube.
NFI.effect: The P3 sigma/rho-bound conclusion stands; the SiC design point does not.

NFI.gap: The film allowable 1.5e9 Pa is an owner assumption with no datasheet, and wrinkling, puncture, sag area and shear transfer to members are unmodelled. For aluminum the film never binds (>=0.838 at the best point), but for SiC and the CNT projection it is the second limit and binds from s=1.0.
NFI.direction: Pin a real film (material, thickness, seaming) before crediting any SiC-family margin.
NFI.effect: SiC-family rows are film-capped in reality until the film is real.

NFI.gap: Node count is the equilateral-continuum formula (equal members, equal tributary area R*s per member, load N=p*R*s/2 — the 002 pinned load path), node hardware 0.02 kg each, and no separate joint or gusset mass exists for P3 in the pinned mass rules.
NFI.direction: Real geodesic load paths and joint masses before any design pick.
